subject: Solstice Systems — Exec intro and demo coverage runbook
messages:
From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@solsticesys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Solstice Systems — Exec intro and demo coverage runbook

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for taking the time last week. Per our conversation, the core ask from your side is a short executive-facing demo for VP/CTO leadership (Anika Rao and David Morales) plus a 20–30 minute technical deep-dive for their engineering leaders.

Quick availability from our side next week:
- Tue 10/20: 10:00–11:00 PT (exec + tech)
- Wed 10/21: 15:00–16:00 PT (exec first, tech after)
- Thu 10/22: 08:30–09:30 PT (exec only, follow-up deep-dive to schedule)

If any of those times work, we’ll send an official calendar invite and a short mutual action plan so you have clarity on pre-reads and attendee expectations. Ben will be the backup exec contact if I’m pulled into a customer escalation.

Two asks from our side:
1) Can you confirm whether Anika prefers recorded sessions?
2) Who from your engineering org should join the technical deep-dive?

I’m attaching a one-page agenda and a mutual action plan draft that we can iterate on.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Demo_Agenda_v1.docx, Solstice_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf

Hi Avery —

Thanks — Tue 10/20 is tight for Anika. Wed 10/21 at 15:00 PT looks promising; she can make the first half (exec overview) but needs to drop after ~25 minutes. David (CTO) prefers not to have the session recorded. For the technical deep-dive, please invite our Head of Platform, Mateo Ruiz (mateo.ruiz@solsticesys.com). He’ll want the implementation sketch and perf numbers.

If you can hold 10/21 15:00–16:00 PT tentatively, we’ll lock calendar once I confirm with Mateo — I should have that within a few hours. Also, can you include a brief runbook for exec Q&A (who handles security questions vs product roadmap)?

Claire Zhang
Head of Partnerships, Solstice Systems
claire.zhang@solsticesys.com

Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Solstice Systems — Exec intro and demo coverage runbook

Folks —

If 10/21 15:00 PT is the working slot, proposed runbook and roles:
- 15:00–15:05 PT: quick intros (Avery)
- 15:05–15:25 PT: executive-facing product highlights and business ROI (Avery)
- 15:25–15:40 PT: CTO-level technical callouts and Q&A (Ben) — cover perf/scale and security boundaries
- 15:40–16:00 PT: technical deep-dive handoff to Mateo + our solutions engineer (follow-up meeting)

Backup plan: If Anika has to leave early, Ben picks up Exec Q&A and we route security questions to me and the solutions engineer.

I’ve updated the mutual action plan with deliverables and timelines and attached it (Solstice_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf). Also added a short FAQ for common exec concerns (recording policy, data retention, SLA ask).

Priyom
Sr. Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom_das@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: Solstice_Mutual_Action_Plan_v2.pdf

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Zhang <claire.zhang@solsticesys.com>, Anika Rao <anika.rao@solsticesys.com>, David Morales <d.morales@solsticesys.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 14:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Confirmed: 10/21 15:00 PT — Exec intro + coverage notes (Solstice)

Claire / Anika / David —

Thanks for confirming availability. I’ve tentatively booked Wed 21 Oct, 15:00–16:00 PT and sent a calendar hold (will convert to final invite once Claire confirms Mateo). Zoom link is in the invite (https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=solstice-demo).

A few quick notes so the execs know what to expect:
- Session will not be recorded (per David’s preference).
- Primary presenters: Avery (exec narrative), Ben (technical callouts).
- If Anika needs to drop early, Ben will handle the remainder of the executive Q&A and Priyom will cover security / architecture follow-ups.
- Action items before the call: we’ll share a 1-page pre-read and the MAP 48 hours before the demo.

Claire — I’ll mark Mateo as optional on the hold; please confirm and I’ll add him to the technical follow-up invite.

Best,
Avery
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwoodinference.com
